notes.title: Patch update
notes.content:
Added some missing lines in the good ending to improve the endings' consistency. My apologies if you got all the endings and found that something wasn't explained; the lines got cut somehow during the edition process.

Please, download it again if you haven't played it yet!

notes.title: Demo available!
notes.content:
We have the pleasure to announce the demo of [i][b]Lurkers[/b][/i] is now available for [b]Windows[/b] on the Steam store. 

Experience the grimmest series of crimes of the Victorian era in this short[b] BL Yaoi Visual Novel[/b], putting yourself in the shoes of the son of the first acknowledged victim of [b]Jack the Ripper[/b]. Follow Eddy Nichols in his quest for revenge and maybe find some love on the side!

Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist to be notified on the launch date!
